crossRefs.note: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell…
What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.”
But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira, as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call…
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have…
Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have…
Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should…
“In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he…
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be…
so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his…
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
“Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but…
I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

parallels.note: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

translations.web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
translations.bsb: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
translations.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
translations.asv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
